en.headline: Police hold helper after report of assault on boy, 5
en.dek: A 37-year-old domestic helper was arrested in Kowloon City after a mother reported that her son had been hit at their Hau Wong Road home.
body: Police have arrested a 37-year-old domestic helper on suspicion of ill-treating a child in her care, after a mother in Kowloon City reported that her five-year-old son had been assaulted.

Officers received the report at about 11pm on Wednesday. The woman told police she suspected her son had been mistreated at their home on Hau Wong Road. Initial inquiries suggested the helper, understood to be from the Philippines, had struck the boy with her hand.

The boy was conscious and complained of pain in his face. He was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital for examination. Police said the helper remained in custody and the case was being followed by the Kowloon City district crime unit.
The woman has been arrested on suspicion of ill-treatment or neglect of a child or young person under her care. She has not been charged. Police have not named her.

zh.headline: 九龍城5歲男童疑遭外傭襲擊 37歲菲傭被捕
zh.dek: 一名母親周三晚報案，指5歲兒子在侯王道住所疑被外傭不當對待，警方以涉嫌虐待受看管兒童拘捕37歲菲傭。
body: 九龍城發生懷疑虐兒事件。警方周三晚上約11時接獲一名母親報案，指5歲兒子在侯王道住所疑被外傭不恰當對待。
警方初步調查相信，該名37歲菲律賓籍外傭曾用手襲擊男童，遂以涉嫌「對所看管兒童或少年人虐待或忽略」將她拘捕。她現正被扣留調查，尚未被落案起訴。警方沒有公布她的姓名。
男童當時清醒，表示面部疼痛，被送往伊利沙伯醫院檢查。案件交由九龍城警區刑事調查隊第一隊跟進。
警方呼籲市民如發現兒童疑受不當對待，應儘快報案。本案仍在調查，所述均屬指控。
